title: Local Research into Nipah Virus Diagnostic Kits and Vaccines
what_it_is: Local Research into Nipah Virus Diagnostic Kits and Vaccines

sections.label: PREPARE Nipah virus research projects
sections.summary: PREPARE funds six Nipah virus research projects by Duke-NUS, NUS and A*STAR, none using live virus, which needs a BSL 4 lab Singapore lacks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: PREPARE is funded under the Research, Innovation and Enterprise (RIE) programme, which can involve collaborations between public sector institutions and private sector firms.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To date, under PREPARE, Duke-NUS, the National University of Singapore (NUS) and the Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) are conducting six research projects on Nipah virus covering diagnostics, therapeutics and vaccines.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: All of these are in progress and do not involve the use of live Nipah virus, which requires a biosafety level (BSL) 4 laboratory.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Singapore currently does not have a BSL 4 laboratory for the purposes of research.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Defence is upgrading the capabilities of DSO National Laboratories to BSL 4.

sections.label: Nipah outbreak localised
sections.summary: The Nipah virus outbreak at this moment is localised.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The Nipah virus outbreak at this moment is localised.

sections.label: Cautious posture, no vaccine procurement
sections.summary: The posture differs from COVID, so procuring vaccine targets now is premature; instead, symptomatic arrivals are contained, isolated, given supportive care and monitored for 14 days.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: It is not the same posture that we adopt as for COVID, which had become a generalised pandemic in that episode we had been through.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, there is probably no urgency at all for now, for us to look at procuring vaccine targets ahead of time in anticipation of a widespread global pandemic.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: For any incoming individuals who may have symptoms, to take proactive actions to contain, to isolate and also to to give them supportive care if necessary; and at the same time, also to help them to monitor their symptoms within the first 14 days of arrival in Singapore, for example.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, we are adopting a cautious posture, but looking for vaccine target at this moment is premature.
